newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TAXI BLOCKADE DELAYS FLIGHTS OUT OF CAPE TOWN.
newsitem.headline: TAXI BLOCKADE DELAYS FLIGHTS OUT OF CAPE TOWN.

text.p: Flights out of Cape Town airport were delayed on Friday morning as rival minibus taxi organisations blockaded the entrance.
South African Airways reported that "an alternative route has been opened to the airport and we are delaying flights for half an hour to enable passengers to get to the airport."
The blockade, which started just before 9 a.m. (0700 GMT) was apparently prompted by rivalry between taxi groups over routes.
